verifier: lane AI (opponents, W1-A / W3-A), independent verifier at HEAD 17c1227ad (rulings 55 + 58)
blockers: BRIDGE back-and-forth regression against the live bots. Novice and adept fighters on BRIDGE now walk back and forth at full health with no enemy within 30 m 5.58 and 3.25 times a game. Live (e2c4925e5) and pre-lane bots do it 0.00-0.04 times, and so did the round-1 build 3b44a0a56 (0.04 / 0.04). Paired over 24 seeds, z +12 and +11. Veteran is unaffected (0.08). This is a new defect, visible to the player, in a mode that ships. It came in after 3b44a0a56 (ruling 55 cce378c68 or the src/sim wip syncs before it). Ruling 58 changes veteran only. The tactics gate checks dither in RIFT only, so it did not catch this.

method.arms: One tree, no worktree. The probes take VALE_BOTS (added in 17c1227ad). A scratch mirror symlinks every src entry except the bot folders, which hold real copies: head (HEAD src/sim/bots), pre (0aeac587b, pre-lane), e2c (e2c4925e5, live ship) and r1 (3b44a0a56, BRIDGE check only). Only the bots differ; every arm used the HEAD probe.
method.sim: probe_sim_bot_tactics on fresh seeds 701-764: 64 RIFT (cut at 30:00) and 24 FRAY a tier, plus BRIDGE seeds 701-724 (24 a tier), for head, pre and e2c. 3 arms x 3 tiers x 112 games = 1,008 games, plus 72 r1 BRIDGE games. Pairs are matched per seed and reported as mean +- SE of the paired difference. HEAD full soak (--full --lineup shuffle) on seeds 1-20 and 21-40. probe_sim_bot_soak quick. probe_sim_bot_tactics at its default seeds. All of these ran under heavy.py. A genesis perf agent SIGSTOPped my head and pre workers for about 24 min mid-run (genesis_perf_tools/paused_pids.txt). They resumed and finished; the sim is deterministic, so results are unaffected.
method.live: Real Chrome (pw.mjs, GPU on) on my own frozen vite :5341 (VALE_FROZEN=1, HEAD tree, dist-catalog built 14:18 today). Seat 0 is the scripted player from round 1 (overextend, dive the carry beside its support, push the middle road into the base), with per-second core-hit and siege monitors. Runs: RIFT veteran s5 and FRAY veteran s9 (brain _tmp_vfy_ai_brain.js), plus RIFT veteran s11 and RIFT adept s11 (brain _tmp_vfy_ai_brain_r1b.js).
method.files: Scratch only, removed after the report: pair tables (pair_rf_3arm, pair_br_hp), gate prints for each arm, soak logs, live reports. The soak reports stay in _harness/_reports/fw_W4_soak_vai58_s1/_s21 (gitignored).

1_base_defence.verdict: NOT MET (better than pre at adept only; novice and veteran-inner worse)
facts: Inner+base falls to Wicks alone beside two fit defenders, a game, pre -> head (paired, n 64, s701-764). Novice 0.56 -> 0.70 (inner +0.05+-0.06, base +0.09+-0.11; worse, within noise). Adept 1.09 -> 0.83 (inner -0.11+-0.09, base -0.16+-0.19; better, within noise). Veteran 0.84 -> 0.88: inner 0.19 -> 0.50 (+0.31+-0.09, z +3.3, worse), base 0.66 -> 0.38 (-0.28+-0.12, z -2.3, better). The requirement is better than pre at every tier. That holds at adept only, and veteran inner falls are significantly worse. Against live e2c, head is better at veteran (1.44 -> 0.88; base -0.58+-0.16, z -3.7) and level elsewhere.

Threat-driven answering improved strongly. Fit fighters 25-80 m away and not closing while the base is hit (s a game), pre -> head: novice 32.1 -> 20.7, adept 11.9 -> 2.8, veteran 16.6 -> 2.1. Unanswered base intrusions: novice 2.09 -> 1.84 (z -1.0, n.s.), adept 0.94 -> 0.56 (z -2.7), veteran 1.77 -> 0.45 (z -6.6). Fit fighters idle beside a hit structure (s a game): 10.0 -> 5.6 / 6.6 -> 4.6 / 5.9 -> 4.7. Against e2c: 12.2 / 14.6 / 12.6 -> 5.6 / 4.6 / 4.7.
Veteran inner+base fighter siege with no defender in 16 m: pre 35.2 % -> head 12.0 % (bar 20). Veteran structure falls a game: inner 4.02 -> 3.67, base 6.63 -> 5.58 (z -3.8).

Deterministic seed-5 blocker: live RIFT veteran s5 on the round-1 script did not reproduce the t1365-1398 idle. In that window the only event was my second dive (I died at 22:52). No base structure was under attack, and no bot idled 10 s or more beside a hit structure. The match ended by core at 27:50 (team 0). In the final base siege (Needle Bells and Hourbell, 26:57-27:50), every siege had at least 1 defender at its start and up to 5 at most. Bot idle episodes of 10 s or more were all 12-25 s at own structures, with no structure under fighter attack.

Live adept s11, base sieges on team 0 (24:58-27:33): Lantern 1498-1521 had 0 defenders at its start and the first came at 13 s. It fell. A Needle Bell fell at 1524-1533 with 1 defender at its start and 3 at most. Fit defenders more than 25 m away while a base structure was hit: 7 fighter-seconds at the Lantern and 7 at the Needle Bell.

head_vs_live_e2c: HEAD is better than the live bots on most measures a player sees, and fog honesty holds in both. RIFT dither is down by 2.1 / 0.8 / 3.0 a game. Idle beside a hit structure is down 7-10 s a game. Veteran base falls to Wicks beside fit defenders drop 0.95 -> 0.38. Invader punishes are 2.8x at veteran. Veteran and adept peel landing are up. FRAY stays are 4-7 points lower, and novice games are 1.6 min shorter. HEAD is worse than live in two places: novice and adept BRIDGE dither (the blocker), and veteran peel no-response (+3.1 a game, z +2.9). Tier separation holds: veteran beats novice 39/40 and 40/40, and beats adept 34/40 and 31/40.
problems: Item 1: inner+base falls to Wicks beside fit defenders are better than pre only at adept. Novice 0.56 -> 0.70, and veteran inner 0.19 -> 0.50 (z +3.3).

Item 2: FRAY low-health stays are 65.5 % adept and 63.0 % veteran against bars of 60 / 50 %. Veteran RIFT dither is 1.30-1.56 against a bar of 1. 1-against-3 objective takes are 0.23-0.48 a game. RIFT low-health stays are worse than pre at novice and adept.

Item 3: games run +1.2 / +2.0 / +2.3 min longer than pre (paired, understated by the 30:00 cut). 14/64 adept and 12/64 veteran games pass 30:00, against 2/64 and 4/64 for pre. Two of three live RIFT matches hit the 28:00 cap, and the third ended 10 s before it. Soak seeds 21-40 have 41-46 min games.
Item 4: adept laners-in-lane 67.5-68.3 % and adept shadehold early takedowns 1.50 are just under pre (68.4 % and 1.60). The gates pass.
Item 5: veteran peel landing within 1.5 s is 70.4-72.7 % against a bar of 75 %.
Item 6: adept and veteran collapse rates are identical (74.5 %). No lurk strike produced a kill.
Item 7: the tactics gate fails 4 at default seeds and 5 at fresh seeds.
BRIDGE dither regression at novice and adept, 5.6 and 3.3 a game against 0 for live and pre (see blockers). The RIFT-only dither gate cannot see it.
summary: Ruling 58's veteran turn latch works: veteran RIFT dither is 1.3 a game against pre's 5.3, and veteran base falls are down. The lane as a whole is clearly smarter than the live bots. Defence is threat-driven, idle-beside-siege is near zero, invaders are punished, peel turn-on is above 90 %, fog collapses are up, and no fog cheating occurs. It still does not meet the bar. Novice and veteran-inner falls to Wicks beside fit defenders are worse than pre. FRAY low-health stays are 63-66 %. Veteran peel landing is 70-73 %. Games run about 2 min longer than pre, and two of three live RIFT matches hit the 28:00 cap. There is also a new BRIDGE back-and-forth regression at novice and adept (5.6 / 3.3 a game, 0 live), which I rate a blocker because it would ship a defect the live bots do not have. Items 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7 are not met, item 4 is borderline and item 6 is measured. Not safe to ship: pace still regresses against pre, and BRIDGE regresses against live.
